name: Inadequate warehouse security -> inventory loss risk
rationale: Unrestricted physical access removes the main barrier to unauthorised removal of goods, so recorded quantities may exceed quantities actually held. The rule directs the auditor to existence-focused substantive procedures and to test the completeness of loss records, with explicit per-assertion reasoning.
source_reference: Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
